purpose: Test direct visual-event supervision of the encoder without changing the flat navigation actor
motivation: Longer corrections produced a first hidden return but no screen success-rate gain; phase readout often predicts return before actual consumption
actorArchitecture: Existing CNN128 -> GRU128 -> flat joint-seven actor, with phase training auxiliary
treatment: Existing training-only 128-to-1 camera-event head reads current visual features before own feedback and recurrence; BCE weight1, first-consumption positive weight50
eventLabels: Derived only from the audited dense pre-action phase transition; never supplied to actor or its recurrent input
evaluation: Exact native forward parity, canonical screens at fixed snapshots and standard loss-selected outputs; paired full32 for promising room-type transfer, then original final gates
warmStartSelection: Epoch0 participates; retain initial weights if no validation improvement
